precepts.text: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god. That is the white man, starting with the Greeks all the way up to today. Here in our captivity we have stretched out our hands to their strange god that you think is Jesus. Whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory. Robbed everything. And he shall cause them to rule over many. He caused his European allies to rule over many. And shall divide the land for gain. They divided the land of Israel and the land of Africa during the Berlin Conference for gain. That is what they did.
precepts.point: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

precepts.why:
“Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.” The place of dragons is the seven heads: the great red dragon with seven heads and their lands, Greece, Rome, Spain, France, Germany, Russia and Great Britain, and the eighth head is America. Why has he covered us with the shadow of death? He has allowed these dragons to teach us lies, as a punishment for us disobeying his commandments. “If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god”: see that part?

Daniel shows the strange god: “Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory.” That is the white man, starting with the Greeks all the way up to today. Here in our captivity we have stretched out our hands to their strange god, the one you think is Jesus. He acknowledged him and increased him with glory, and robbed everything.

“and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.” He caused his European allies to rule over many. They divided the land of Israel and the land of Africa at the Berlin Conference for gain. That's what they did.

So now we stretch out our hands to a strange god: white Jesus. Like the black woman in the video: Jesus is white, he's the white man, you look like Jesus, long hair, you are Jesus. We have stretched out our hands to a strange god and forgotten the name of our God. “They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.” White Jesus is a strange god; Allah is a strange god. “If ye forsake the Lord, and serve strange gods, then he will turn and do you hurt, and consume you, after that he hath done you good.” Have we not been hurt, in slavery, captivity, oppression and poverty? “There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.” Yet we worship a god that doesn't look like us, act like us or talk like us, and want that strange god to bless us when he has done nothing but hurt us. Some of your mothers and fathers have that damn crucifix around their necks and on the walls of their houses.

“Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.” We have envied the oppressor and chosen his strange god and his strange religion. “Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.” We want into their politics, their religions, their schools; we want to look like them. The churches have done us a disservice. And the Lord knows it: “Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.” We cry, “Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord?”, and want him to intervene now, but he says, y'all have got to get yourselves together, men and women, and get right according to my word.

note.label: Drowning in Sin & Perdition

precepts.why:
Daniel says the same thing we just read in Thessalonians: “the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.” Paul’s man of sin “exalteth himself above all that is called God”; Daniel’s king magnifies himself “above every god.” It is one and the same.

The son of perdition is not one man. Christians say it is the pope, or this one guy, but it is talking about a race of people. Not just one old man with a yarmulke on his head, though he is included in that. Who opposes and exalts himself above all that is called God? The white man. And “he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: his churches. If you want salvation, you have to go to his churches; then the white guy says all black churches should close down and come learn under white people.

In the time of Rome, in 70 AD, Titus did exactly what we read: he went and sat his rear behind in the temple. But bring it up to today, because Israel went into slavery. The bust of the savior found in the church of San Salvador in Onda is an open secret among the Europeans: Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander, posed for it, crown of thorns and all. The Last Supper is Cesare in the center, with his sister Lucrezia in there twice and his father Rodrigo Borgia more than once; Lucrezia was having sex with her brother. They put themselves in the place of God, and many of our northern kingdom brothers and sisters, some of our mothers and fathers, glorify it.

The Seventh Day Adventists say they use no images of Christ, and they have Cesare Borgia as Christ. The Jehovah’s Witnesses say nobody knows what Christ looks like, then put a white man in their comic books. Or they say it doesn’t matter what color Jesus is; then why is every image white? That conditioning, starting with 14th century Renaissance art, put them in a position of superiority and made our people feel inferior. That is the king magnifying himself above every god, and he shall prosper “till the indignation be accomplished.”

Daniel shows it: “Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”. That white Jesus is a strange god. “And he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.” The white man divided Africa for gain. That is what the Bible says he did.

Why is that god strange? Because he does not look like you. He has no laws, statutes or commandments. And he whooped you in slavery. That is why we send brothers out, only brothers with a good name: “How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!” The glad tidings are that you are the Israelites, Christ died for you and your race, and he is coming back to save our race.

precepts.why:
The same thing Daniel wrote in chapter 11, verses 36 to 39, is recorded in 2 Thessalonians 2:4: “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped”. To oppose means you go against. Daniel said the king would “exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god”; the Greeks did this, Rome did this, and America has done the same thing.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: his temples are the temples of God. “shewing himself that he is God”: all his images show him as God, as the Son of God, as the angels, as the Jews. What we read in 2 Thessalonians 2 is the same thing Daniel prophesied the white man would do.

In the Pillory, the tale of the Borgia pope, explains it: it is an open secret that Cesare Borgia, the son of Pope Alexander, posed for the new image of Jesus, with the crown of thorns and the thin hair; Salvator means Saviour. That is the strange god Daniel spoke of, “a god whom his fathers knew not”, which “he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”.

Paul warned of it: “For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”. This is another Jesus; you won't find a scripture describing Jesus like this. And what comes with another Jesus is another spirit, an antichrist spirit, and another gospel. Black Christians love to say it doesn't matter what he looks like, only his message; but a gospel where all races come together in the name of white Jesus, the apostles never taught or accepted. That ain't in the Bible.

He has fooled the world into thinking he serves the God of the Bible, but he does not. He honours “the God of forces”, the god of weaponry and destruction, he causes his lieutenants and generals “to rule over many”, and he divides “the land for gain”, as Alexander's four generals did, and as Europe divided up Africa at the Berlin Conference.

note.label: Religion - The False Prophet

precepts.why:
Daniel says “the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god”. Paul says of the man of sin, “Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped”. This is the same wording as Daniel; they are talking about the same thing. He magnifies himself against Islam, Judaism, Buddhism, whatever it is. He magnifies himself as God, and that is the white Jesus.

“so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God”: he says his churches are the churches of God. “shewing himself that he is God”: that is this white man. What we read in Thessalonians is identifying the false prophet in the last days, and it is the same king who in Daniel honours “a god whom his fathers knew not” and does his work “with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”. The strange god is the white Jesus.

How was that strange god made? “For the devising of idols was the beginning of spiritual fornication, and the invention of them the corruption of life.” “For a father afflicted with untimely mourning, when he hath made an image of his child soon taken away, now honoured him as a god”. It happened with Nimrod, Osiris, Julius Caesar, Alexander and Hercules, all worshipped as gods after their deaths. And it happened with Pope Alexander VI and his son Caesar Borgia: the father died before the son, but it was the father's instruction to use his son as white Jesus. It is an open secret that Caesar Borgia posed for the bust of the Saviour.

“Thus in process of time an ungodly custom grown strong was kept as a law, and graven images were worshipped by the commandments of kings.” The custom of worshipping the white man as Jesus grew strong in the earth; there are images of Caesar as Jesus in Brazil, New York, Mexico, you name it. “For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” Christianity is an idolatrous religion.

John saw the same beast: “he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God”. The white man set himself up as God and went against all God's laws; that is the function of the Roman Catholic Church. “it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”: Spain and Portugal made war against the saints of God and overcame us in slavery. “And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him”. That is the man who exalts himself above all that is called God.

note.label: Prophesy From Pain to Peace

precepts.why:
Alexander “parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”, and “his servants bare rule every one in his place.” His generals divided it up: Ptolemy took Egypt, Lysimachus took Thrace and Asia Minor, Seleucus took Syria, and Cassander took Macedonia. Alexander had everything united as one; they could not unite, so they divided the kingdom.

Daniel shows the pattern: “Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge and increase with glory”. Back then, in the time of the Greeks, the strange gods were Zeus, Aphrodite and the like. The strange god today is Caesar Borgia.

It goes on, “and he shall cause them to rule over many”: he causes his people to rule over many nations, many countries. He “shall divide the land for gain.” That is what Alexander's generals did.

Many of these scriptures have levels to them. It started with the Greeks, but Esau kept that same energy at the Berlin Conference in the late 1800s. No Africans, no Negroes and no Latinos were in that meeting; it was about white supremacy, and they divided up the entire continent of Africa for gain, and the land of Israel with it. That is what the Balfour Declaration was about: some of these so-called Khazars wanted that land.

Then the Herodians, Herod and Agrippa, robbed our culture and our heritage and became Jews in the time of Christ. And in 1948 they got the land again, set up schools throughout Israel and taught a new form of Hebrew, a Hebrew that was extinct from 70 AD and made up by fusing French, Arabic, Aramaic, Spanish and German words, which Negroes argue about today. They got the land, made up a new language, and called themselves Jewish. But the prophecy says, “they shall fall.”

precepts.why:
Here God shows what those robbers said when they took the land. “I have heard all thy blasphemies which thou hast spoken against the mountains of Israel, saying, They are laid desolate, they are given us to consume.” They said, the real Jews are gone, the Israelites are finished, the land is ours now. “Thus with your mouth ye have boasted against me, and have multiplied your words against me: I have heard them.” God said, I have heard them.

“When the whole earth rejoiceth, I will make thee desolate.” That is when they shall say peace and safety. “As thou didst rejoice at the inheritance of the house of Israel, because it was desolate”: they rejoiced over the land because the twelve tribes were gone and put in captivity. “so will I do unto thee: thou shalt be desolate, O mount Seir, and all Idumea, even all of it”.

Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. It does not say some of Idumea; it says all Idumea, even all of it. That is who the robbers of thy people are: Edom, which is Amalek over there, set themselves up as the Jews. Their plan is to make believe Iran shot a missile and blew up the Al-Aqsa Mosque so they can rebuild the third temple. But when the whole earth rejoices, God makes them desolate: “but they shall fall.”

precepts.why:
“Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea, which have appointed my land into their possession”. This verse, along with Ezekiel 35:12, identifies the race that would live in the land. It doesn't say Japheth. There is no biblical text that says Japheth lives in the land. The Bible says Idumea would take and live in the land.

“with the joy of all their heart”: they were happy to steal, to spoil the land. “with despiteful minds”: they took the land despite knowing the land doesn't belong to them, despite the fact they're not the Jews.

“to cast it out for a prey”: they called their fellow Idumeans from Poland, Russia, Germany, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan and Ukraine and said, come, take a part, and a lot of them came. That is why, if you listen to them speak, they speak German, Polish and Russian with those accents. They are not the people of the land.

That is the vision the robbers of thy people exalt themselves to establish in Daniel 11:14, and God has spoken against all Idumea in the fire of his jealousy. They shall fall.

note.label: The Real Reason Iran Was Attacked

precepts.why:
“the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision”. Who are the robbers of God's people? Daniel 9:27 shows what they do: “And he shall confirm the covenant with many for one week: and in the midst of the week he shall cause the sacrifice and the oblation to cease”. This is what Antiochus did: he stopped us from sacrificing and serving God.

“and for the overspreading of abominations he shall make it desolate”: he set up abomination and made our people desolate, meaning he destroyed our people, “even until the consummation”. That is why the Greeks, and the white man after them, are called the abomination of desolation, the abomination that maketh desolate. They are the robbers of God's people.

The Greeks wanted to conquer and take the land of Israel, and not only the land. First Maccabees 3 shows they took the book of the law and painted their likeness and their images in it, robbing us of our culture too. Judas Maccabeus rose up and fought against them.

And it is not only the Greeks. Christ said, “When ye therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place”. In the time of the Greeks the abomination was the Greeks; in the time of Christ it was the Romans; and Europe is an extension of Rome. In 1949 Europeans from Germany, Poland, Russia and Ukraine went into the holy land saying, we are the people of God. Today the abomination of desolation is those people in the land calling themselves Jews and they are not: the Europeans, the Edomites. Why are they called that? Because they destroy everything; ask the Palestinians.

When they stand in the holy place, “then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.” They are the ones who will instigate it. But Daniel 11:14 ends, “but they shall fall.” The same way they fell back then is the same way they are going to fall today.

note.label: Daniel 11: The Kings of the North and the South

precepts.why:
The vile person obtains the kingdom by flatteries, and Maccabees gives a small example of the greediness of the gang. “one Simon of the tribe of Benjamin, who was made governor of the temple, fell out with the high priest about disorder in the city.” When he could not overcome Onias, he went to Apollonius the son of Thraseas, the governor of Celosyria and Phenice, “And told him that the treasury in Jerusalem was full of infinite sums of money, so that the multitude of their riches, which did not pertain to the account of the sacrifices, was innumerable, and that it was possible to bring all into the king’s hand.”

Simon informed on the treasury in Jerusalem so it could be brought into the king's hand. That is the greed at work in the kingdom that comes in peaceably and is obtained by flatteries.
